items.title: Israel 'tried to intimidate' Irish amid spitting row - Hallgrimsson
items.description: Republic of Ireland head coach Heimir Hallgrimsson says he felt Israel were "trying to intimidate" his team amid allegations of spitting during Sunday's Nations League draw.

items.title: No other team should go through this - Hallgrimsson
items.description: Republic of Ireland manager Heimir Hallgrimsson says he is "delighted" this most trying of international windows is over and hopes "no national team to go through what we have gone through over the last two weeks".

items.title: Bellamy bemoans new schedule after Denmark loss
items.description: Craig Bellamy suggests the new four-match international window has counted against Wales after Sunday's Nations League defeat against Denmark.

items.title: Portugal boss says door open for Ronaldo return
items.description: Cristiano Ronaldo could still return for Portugal, according to boss Jorge Jesus.

items.title: Zirkzee gets the winner for Netherlands against Serbia
Hojlund pen condemns Wales to third Nations League defeat in four
items.description: Wales suffered a 1-0 Nations League defeat to Denmark as Rasmus Hojlund scored the game's only goal from the penalty spot.

items.title: Republic of Ireland draw with Israel in second Nations League meeting
items.description: The Republic of Ireland drew 1-1 with Israel in the second controversial Nations League fixture between the sides.

items.title: Fans group questions Desmond's priorities amid Celtic protest row
items.description: The Celtic Fans Collective has criticised Dermot Desmond's "priorities" after the Scottish champions withdrew recognition of the group following a protest against the major shareholder at the Alfred Dunhill Links golf tournament in St Andrews.

items.title: Man City fight back to beat struggling Arsenal
items.description: Manchester City twice came from behind to beat Arsenal 4-2 at the Etihad Stadium and increase the pressure on Gunners manager Renee Slegers.

items.title: You are the Scotland boss - what would you do?
items.description: Put yourself in the shoes of the new Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli as he picks his XI to face Slovenia on Tuesday.

items.title: Arsenal 10 points off WSL leaders - is Slegers' job at risk?
items.description: It is only five matches into the WSL season but Arsenal are already 10 points behind leaders Manchester City and manager Renee Slegers is coming under increasing scrutiny.
